findings.title: esbuild enables any website to send any requests to the development server and read the response
findings.reason: DEPS-001: dev-only @esbuild-kit/* chain under drizzle-kit. The only fix is a drizzle-kit pre-release. The advisory is about esbuild's dev server accepting cross-origin requests, and drizzle-kit generate/migrate never start one.

findings.title: source-map-js allows event-loop denial of service through indexed source-map section offsets
React Router: Open redirect via backslash in <Link> and useNavigate (CVE-2025-68470 bypass)
findings.reason: DEPS-001: react-router-dom stays on v6 (v7 needs Node >=20, baseline is 18.19.1, ADR-0004). The advisory is about open redirects and SSR hydration. The app has no SSR and feeds no attacker-controlled path to <Link> or useNavigate.
